faqs.question: What is AITI and where is the campus located?
faqs.answer: AITI (AFTATECH INFORMATION TECHNOLOGICAL INSTITUTE) is a premier technology training institute under AFTATECH.IT CONSULT. We are located at 2 Babanla Street, Graceland Junction, Tanke, Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria.

faqs.question: What programs are currently available at AITI?
faqs.answer: We offer an intensive 3-Month Certificate Program and a comprehensive 6-Month Diploma Program across Web Development, Data Science, AI, UI/UX, Hardware & Networking, AutoCAD/Revit, and Cyber Defense.

faqs.question: How do I apply for the 2026/2027 admission session?
faqs.answer: Click 'APPLY NOW' on the portal, complete the 8-step application form, upload your passport photograph and credentials, pay the application fee securely, and track your application status.

faqs.question: Are installment payment options available for school fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, AITI supports structured installment payment plans for both Certificate and Diploma programs. You can pay an initial deposit before class commencement and balance in agreed milestones.

faqs.question: Do you offer weekend or evening executive classes?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide flexible weekday morning/afternoon schedules, Saturday weekend intensives, and evening executive classes tailored for working professionals and university students.

faqs.question: Are AITI certificates verifiable online?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every certificate and admission letter issued by AITI contains a unique reference number and a secure QR code verifiable instantly on our public Verification Portal.
